image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a metallic green tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) positioned on a textured wooden surface. The beetle exhibits a vibrant emerald green exoskeleton with distinct pale cream-colored spots on its elytra. Its head features large, bulging compound eyes and prominent, curved mandibles. The antennae are long and segmented. The legs are slender and spiny, gripping the wood grain. There is visible text in the bottom left corner.
